thread:
sam.k: Hey support — customer hitting 400 when calling tool/function. Says: "schema validation failed: tool arguments invalid JSON". Repro attached.

alexa_support: Thanks Sam. Can you paste the exact payload they send and the API response body?

sam.k: Payload (redacted customer id):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"gpt-redwood-1\",
  \"tool_call\": {
    \"name\": \"invoice_generator\",
    \"arguments\": '\\"invoice_id\\": 12345,\\n\'description\': \\"monthly charge\\",
  }
}
```
Response body: `400 Bad Request` + JSON: `{ "error": "invalid_tool_arguments", "message": "Malformed JSON in tool arguments: trailing comma or invalid quoting" }`

alexa_support: Ah — arguments field is a raw single-quoted string that contains unescaped quotes and a trailing comma. Tool parser expects a valid JSON object (double quotes) or a properly escaped JSON string. Looks like the client (customer JS) interpolated a JS object into a string incorrectly.

maria_j: Do we have logs from the validation layer? support-bot: validation.failure at 2026-03-16T18:45:12Z - parser=toolargs - err=unexpected_token at char 28

sam.k: Here's the curl they used (customer-supplied):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","tool_call":{"name":"invoice_generator","arguments":"'invoice_id': 12345, 'description': "monthly charge",",}}'
```

raj_p: Thanks. Reproduced locally — parser chokes as expected. Quick notes:
- The arguments value in this payload is not valid JSON (single quotes, mismatched double quotes, trailing comma).
- Our tool-call contract: `tool_call.arguments` must be either a JSON object (server-side parsed) or a JSON-encoded string with escaped double-quotes. We don't accept raw single-quoted JS-literal strings.

maria_j: Could we return a clearer error? Instead of generic "Malformed JSON in tool arguments" maybe include guidance: "tool_call.arguments must be valid JSON (use double quotes) or a JSON-escaped string (use JSON.stringify)".

raj_p: Agreed, we can make the validator message more actionable. I'll add a hint and a small snippet. For now workaround to give customer: send arguments as an object or JSON.stringify the object. Example fixes:
```json
// send as object in body (preferred)
{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","tool_call":{"name":"invoice_generator","arguments":{"invoice_id":12345,"description":"monthly charge"}}}

// or send as JSON-escaped string
{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","tool_call":{"name":"invoice_generator","arguments":"{\"invoice_id\":12345,\"description\":\"monthly charge\"}"}}
```

alexa_support: Sam, can you forward that to the customer and ask them to try both approaches? Also which SDK/language are they using?

sam.k: They're using a homegrown JS wrapper around fetch. I'll ask for the snippet.

sam.k: Customer responded with snippet: `const payload = { model: 'gpt-redwood-1', tool_call: { name: 'invoice_generator', arguments: JSON.stringify({ invoice_id: 12345, description: 'monthly charge', }) } }` — after I told them to JSON.stringify it, they still got 400.

alexa_support: Hmm — did they accidentally include a trailing comma inside the JSON.stringify content or later mutate the string? Ask them to `console.log(payload.tool_call.arguments)` and paste output.

sam.k: They pasted console log: `{"invoice_id":12345,"description":"monthly charge",}` — there's a trailing comma inside the string coming from their serializer. It appears their custom serializer appends a comma when building strings.

raj_p: That trailing comma will still break our strict JSON.parse. We should consider being more tolerant (strip a single trailing comma inside object) but that's risky. For now best fix is to remove trailing commas on client side. I'll open a quick internal ticket to evaluate optional lenient parsing and risk.

maria_j: Ticket good. Title: "validator: consider tolerant parsing for trailing commas in tool_call.arguments". Assign to eng-runtime.

alexa_support: Also added improved error hint to validator (PR queued) — it will include exact snippet of how to format arguments.

sam.k: Customer patched serializer, retried, success. They got 200 and tool executed. They said thanks.

raj_p: Recording notes: root cause = client-built argument string with single quotes + trailing comma from custom serializer. Fixes: customer updated to use valid JSON; support docs updated with explicit examples; follow-up ticket to evaluate tolerant parsing in validator.

maria_j: Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
